newsitem.title: MEXICO: GCC unveils tariff damage-limitation plan.
newsitem.headline: GCC unveils tariff damage-limitation plan.

text.p: Mexican cement maker Grupo Cementos de Chihuahua announced on Friday a series of measures to contain the adverse effects of increased anti-dumping tariffs to be levied on Mexican cement sales to the United States.
The measures include appealing the U.S. decision, cutting U.S. distribution costs and selling cement produced at plants the company operates in the United States.
The U.S. Department of Commerce announced on Thursday it would raise anit-dumping tariffs on Mexican cement to 103.82 percent from 62 percent.
GCC is based in northern Mexico and depends more than other leading Mexican cement manufacturers on exports to the United States.
